public_definitions: Task goal: 'Review the browser market share dashboard, then select the browser product that should be set as the primary compatibility target.'

uncertain: The y-axis has no printed unit label; the bars are interpreted as percentage share because each bar carries a '%' data label.

The printed data labels do not match the bar heights (e.g., Chrome's '73%' label sits on a bar reaching ~66, Safari's '12%' label sits on the tallest bar reaching ~71), so it is unclear whether the labels or the bar geometry represent the intended share values.
The sum of the printed labels (73+12+2+6+7) exceeds 100, so the labels are not a consistent single-scale share distribution.
No legend is present; series identity is taken solely from the x-axis category labels.
